title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper Zero-Value Code Specialization via Profile-Guided Control Data Flow Analysis
problem: Reproducibility report for optimization work (code specialization via profile-guided analysis).
motivation: SC reproducibility initiatives require artifact evaluation and documentation.
method: We ran the code and experiments from the original paper ourselves, following SC25's official standards for reproducibility evaluation. We used the same hardware setup and workloads they described, measured whether we got similar performance results, and documented any differences. This process checks if someone else can get the same results when they follow the original paper's instructions.
key_novelty: This paper verifies whether another paper's claimed performance improvements actually happen when you run their code yourself.
limitations: Meta-paper; limited technical content without parent paper access.
